instance_description:
Setting: 2026 mobility records for a Chicago-based robotics competition field technical advisor traveling among schools, convention centers, campuses, airports, hotels, and transit hubs.
Scope: Covers CTA and Metra trips, rideshare links, regional rail and air travel, multi-stop event days, lodging transfers, itinerary changes, badge/document readiness, packing tools, and delays.
Resources: Personal records, working notes, and app history provide the background for recurring activities within this scope.
Exclusions: No student records, robot repair work, event scoring, employer payroll, vehicle maintenance.
personal_description:
Identity: Celia Maren Whitlock is a freelance FIRST-style robotics field technical advisor living in Chicago, Illinois.
Responsibilities: She reaches inspections, volunteer briefings, matches, workshops, airports, hotels, and sponsor demonstrations on time while carrying field laptop accessories and event credentials.
Authority: Celia may choose her routes, buy passenger fares, adjust her own reservations, organize travel documents, coordinate personal arrival windows, and prepare packing or contingency notes.
Restrictions: She does not book travel for teams, handle minors’ private information, change competition schedules, maintain vehicles, purchase robot parts, or perform unrelated household tasks.
